STORAGE & PUBLISHING SETUP

GitHub-Backed Cloud Publishing

RECOMMENDED ONE-TIME SETUP (PASSWORD-ONLY PUBLISHING FROM ANY DEVICE)
  1. Open GitHub Fine-Grained Tokens ↗ and create a token with access to Only select repositories → saintgordon/saint-gordon.
  2. Under Repository permissions, set Contents → Read and write, then click Generate token.
  3. In Vercel → Settings → Environment Variables ↗, add GITHUB_TOKEN with that token and trigger one redeploy.
OPTIONAL: BROWSER-ONLY FALLBACK TOKEN

Want to publish right now before adding the Vercel env var? Paste a scoped GitHub token here — it stays strictly in this browser’s local storage and is sent only with your authenticated admin requests.
